body:
Findings of the fresh-eyes review of the whole 3.1.0 → HEAD delta (upgrade path, single-account
leftovers, web/server). Fix in one pass before the release checklist is run on a device.

## P2

1. **A list pulled again gets a new local id, so its mutes and the last-opened list detach.**
   `SyncEngine.mergeList` (and `mergeItem`) mint `UUID.randomUUID()` for a row the account does not
   hold. After a 410 re-base, or a re-sign-in after a 3.1.0 logout, every clean list comes back under
   a fresh id: notification mutes (keyed by local id) are silently lost, the stored last-opened list
   points at nothing, and an open list screen (5-second re-sync) sits on a deleted row. Rule, the one
   MIGRATION_9_10 established: the first row on this phone for a server id uses the server id as its
   local id; only when another account already holds that local id is a UUID minted. Same for items.
   Tests: a muted list stays muted across a re-base; two accounts sharing a list get local ids
   serverId and a UUID.
2. **A migrated signed-out row is locked to 3.1.0's last typed URL, which can be wrong** (3.1.0 saved
   the URL on every submit, before the server answered; a row can also have no URL at all). "Sign
   in again" then shows the wrong or empty URL read-only, and Accounts → Add with the right URL
   creates a second row for the same account (its lists show twice; the old row's unpushed rows are
   never pushed). Fix: the URL is editable while the row's server is unconfirmed
   (`serverProtocol == null`); `login(expect = Account(rowId))` adopts the URL the user signed in
   with when the response's accountId matches the row. Test both.

## P3

3. A migrated signed-in row keeps `serverProtocol = NULL` while auto update checks are off, so a
   future gated feature would never unlock: after the first successful sync of an account whose
   `serverProtocol` is null, ask that server's `/app-version` once (unbound client) and store it.
   Also `UpdateChecker` must not clear a stored protocol on a 200 that carries none.
4. Two logins on one server sharing a list: the phone notifies itself about its own edit (B's pull
   sees `last_touched_by = A`). Skip rows whose `last_touched_by` is the server account id of another
   account on this phone with the same server URL. Test.
5. The overall sync status shows "Not synced yet" while any server account is signed out or outdated
   (`SyncStatus.publish` takes `lastSyncAt = null` if any account has null): leave signed-out and
   outdated accounts out of the `lastSyncAt`/`lastError` aggregate, keep their pending/blocked counts.
   Test.
6. Strings that still assume one server, Android-only so the English can change (nine locales):
   `about_auto_update_check_help` ("Ask this server…" → the servers of your accounts),
   `update_required_body` and `update_required_unavailable` (may be several servers),
   `login_msg_untrusted_cert` (the toggle is on this form and on the Account screen, not in
   Settings), `api_error_cannot_delete_self` (Android text → "…on its account page"; the web keeps
   "in Settings", so the pair splits: confirm crossClient.test.ts still passes).
7. Removing an account no longer ends its server session (3.1.0's logout called `/logout`): in
   `removeAccount`, a best-effort `api.logout()` before the token is deleted, as `refuse()` does.
8. An outdated account has no way to update once the full-screen block is suppressed (another account
   works, or a local area exists) and auto-check is off: a "Check for update" action on the outdated
   banner (overview) and row (Accounts) that runs `UpdateChecker.checkForced()` and offers the
   download like About does. Nine locales for the label if a new one is needed (reuse
   `about_check_now`-style strings if they exist).
9. Delete the unscoped `ItemDao/ListDao.dirtyRows()`, `blockedRowCount()` and their repo wrappers
   (`ItemsRepo/ListsRepo.dirtyRows`, `clearDirty` if unused outside tests); move their tests to the
   per-account variants. Move the T-74 KDoc from `activeListCountForAccount` to
   `anyActiveListServerIdForAccount`.
10. Docs: `docs/wire-contract.md` "The client's floor" and `server/README.md`: a 3.0.x/3.1.x server
    that serves no APK answers the 404 without `protocol` and is refused by this app, so such an
    instance must run server 3.2.0 or newer before its users sign in (or sign in again) with the new
    app. Current behaviour, one sentence each.

## For the release notes, not code (recorded here so it is not forgotten)

* The landing page's "Open in app" link now carries the mount path; a 3.1.0 app on a mounted server
  does not match it. Deploy the server, then install the app right away.
* Set the floor table's "Since" to the release version when cutting it.
title: Release readiness follow-ups: stable local ids on re-pull, editable URL for migrated rows, self-notification, status aggregate, one-server strings, docs
